h1: Plywood exporter to Bangladesh: packing plywood, crates and pallets from Kochi
lede: A short lane lets you order against a project rather than a forecast. We press packing-grade plywood, and build boxes, crates and pallets, in Perumbavoor, Kerala — 40 km from Cochin Port — and quote it FOB Cochin in USD.
tldr: In short: Cochin Wood Industries is a plywood manufacturer in Kerala, India, exporting to Bangladesh. The core range is packing-grade MR plywood to IS 303 in 6-18 mm, ready-made boxes and crates, and pallets with ISPM-15 treated solid-wood components. USD quotes, FOB Cochin, replies within one business day.
faq: Which port in Bangladesh do you ship plywood to?

The one you nominate. We sell FOB Cochin, so your forwarder books the ocean carriage and names the discharge port; we manufacture, pack, complete Indian export clearance and deliver the goods on board. Tell us the port at enquiry and it goes on the proforma invoice.
Will my shipment qualify for a duty concession as Indian-origin goods?

We do not give customs rulings and we will not promise a duty outcome. What we do is confirm the HS code each product ships under and prepare the Certificate of Origin a preference claim needs. Whether a concession applies to your line, and on what rules-of-origin conditions, is for your clearing agent to confirm — ask before you order, not after.
Can you supply ISPM-15 stamped crates and pallets for onward export?

Yes. Plywood panels are exempt from ISPM-15, but the solid-wood packing we ship — pallets, runners and bearers — is treated and stamped, so cargo repacked in Bangladesh for onward export is not held for want of a mark.
What are your payment terms for buyers in Bangladesh?
50% advance with the order and the balance before dispatch for standard products; 100% advance for custom specifications. Payment is by bank transfer (T/T), and quotes are in USD.
cta_p: Send thickness, sheet size, grade and monthly quantity, or the internal dimensions if you want cases built. A USD FOB Cochin quotation comes back within one business day. sales@cochinwood.in — +91 95674 10175.
